svg.title: Living substrate — graph as center of gravity
svg.desc: The five-graph substrate sits at the center. Five forces orbit it: spec input, LM candidates, evidence, normalization, and harness evolution. Arrows show what flows into and out of the substrate. Every artifact is either a projection, a proposed mutation, evidence, or rejected drift.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the graph substrate and why is it the center of truth?')
sendPrompt('What is the SpecGraph?')

sendPrompt('What is the LineageGraph and why is it the most valuable?')
sendPrompt('What are the six drift classes and what happens to each?')
g.text: drift: conforming · violation · omission · bloat · refinement · dead
